issues.title: Planning Messages List not updated on Message Archived
issues.body:
I'm logged in twice, once as `blue mtg-1` and once as `adjudicator-1`.

When I archive a message, the blue player messages list doesn't update to remove the archived message.

Steps to reproduce:
- log in as a blue player, switch to `Orders` tab. Check you can see `Blue-3`
- login as adjudictor
- switch to orders tab
- select order titled `Blue-3`
- select `Archive` from top-right
- confirm archive
- note that `Blue-3` remains visible for blue player

**Note:** I've tried to trace this.  The updated set of messages gets through `planning-channel`, but `support-panel` doesn't seem to update.
